description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pudur (Block 01) Thamankaduwa  D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No.120323 (25/120001)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land and property-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral maps, land title settlements, and property claims across multiple districts - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories like legal frameworks, commercial matters, elections, etc.
